declarations.description:
A dropdown built from a trigger button and a `c2-list` of `c2-list-item` rows inside a `c2-overlay` popover. The
rows are the light-DOM children of the select, so they are themed with the `--c2-list-item--*` variables directly on
the select (or on a wrapper); the dropdown container is themed through the `--c2-select__list--*` variables and the
trigger through `--c2-select__button--*`. The select has no intrinsic width: give the host a `width` (or place it in
a grid/flex cell) and the trigger fills it.
declarations.name: Select

cssProperties.description: Space between the icons and the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-select__button--gap

cssProperties.description: Defaults to the trigger text colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-select__button__prefix-icon--color

cssProperties.description: The dropdown scrolls past this height.
cssProperties.name: --c2-select__list--max-height

slots.description: The options: `c2-list-item` elements, each with a `value`.
slots.name: default

slots.description: Icon shown at the start of the trigger: an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon`.
slots.name: button-prefix-icon

slots.description: Icon shown at the end of the trigger. Defaults to a chevron that flips while open.
slots.name: button-suffix-icon

slots.description: Replaces the trigger text entirely (selected labels or placeholder) with custom markup.
slots.name: button-content

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the dropdown is showing. Reflects the popover state; set it to open or close programmatically.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the current value but never opens the dropdown.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the trigger and ignores interaction.

members.name: focused
members.description: True while the trigger has keyboard focus.

members.name: fitSize
members.description: Make the dropdown exactly as wide as the trigger instead of at least as wide.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown in the trigger while nothing is selected.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the trigger and option list.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Allow several options to be selected; the dropdown stays open after a pick and the trigger lists every label.

members.name: required
members.description: Keep at least one option selected: picking the only selected option again does not clear it.

members.name: value
members.description: Selected values. Written as `value="a;b"` in markup, read as `['a', 'b']` from the property.

events.description: Fired after the user picks an option. `detail.value` is the array of selected values (one entry unless `multiple`), `detail.data` the `data` of each selected row.
events.name: selection-change
